utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I haven't got the latest myself. I can check on it while I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, that’d help. Let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on it and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll meet you by the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is still on, right? Just checking I have that straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, it’s still on, as far as I know. I’m just a bit worried about whether the timing and parts are lined up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s still on, but the timing and parts might still be shaky?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring over a hammer and then got distracted, but I can still help if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can do that. I just need to stop by and grab a few things first, then I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you go over the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I have everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive. It’s the thing with the tools and the pickup stuff... I might be missing a detail, but that’s the gist.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. So it’s the tools and pickup stuff, and if you remember any missing detail later, let me know before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs another pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush, we could use you on the porch trim and the stack by the garage. I’ll point you to the first one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll take the porch trim first and then help with the stack by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Gus. Just let me know what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a ladder if we need them. Let’s make a quick list of the fixes and get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, let’s make that list and tackle the easy fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m tracking it. Where exactly is the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at the community center on Maple, right by the elementary school. I can text you the exact room number if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps. Text me the room number if you can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam today. Folks are dropping off tools and supplies all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds like the right kind of turnout for it. I’m going to swing by later and drop off a few things myself.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that should help a lot. If you spot anything extra folks need, bring it along too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m starting around 9. If that changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I’ll be there around 9 then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can pass along what’s needed, but I may need the details first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, just send me the details and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’m keeping a clear list of the repair drive jobs, and I’ll make sure we match each one with the right helper.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help with a few of the smaller repairs if that still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would help a lot, thank you. I’ll put you down for the smaller repairs and keep the list balanced.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive's got people talking already - I heard they’re still short a few hands, so it’d help to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know, and if folks can spare even an hour, that'd make a real difference.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly the shelves and the loose outlet cover in the hall, if you can grab a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can grab the screwdriver and take a look at those shelves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the front steps and the hinge on the shed door. I can show you where.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, show me the steps first, then we can check the shed hinge.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just need the address for the repair drive drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s 123 Maple Street. I can text you the gate code too if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help keep folks on the same page about it. What part of the repair drive needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, so I want to check the details first. Is there a specific task you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not a specific task yet, just checking the details with you first. Once I know what’s needed, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have missed the update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The date shifted a bit, and we tightened up what needs fixing first. I’ll send you the latest list if you want it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, send me the latest list when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive's moving along. Gus said he'd swing by after errands to check on it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m on it. I’ll swing by after I finish my errands and see what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’m glad it’s moving. Let me know what you find when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the basics: flashlight, a Phillips screwdriver, and a 10mm wrench.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll bring those basics.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should probably line up the materials and timing first so nobody’s left waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people are we planning for, and what materials do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Probably around six to eight people, and I still need the fasteners, patch tape, and a couple of safety gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing, I’ll spread the word and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll start checking our supply list and set aside anything we can spare for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it, and I’ll check with a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I figure out the school pickup times. What day were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about Saturday morning? I might have mixed up the day, but that should give us time to get the repair drive set up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me, assuming I can get the pickup wrapped up in time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Nell. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where they can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. Just point me to where I can help, and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Nell — you can start at the west end of the block, where we’re handling the loose steps and the porch rail.
